guide.summary: Churches, museums, thermal baths and a market hall, with breakfast cafés, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Several museums close on Mondays, including the Hungarian National Museum, the Museum of Ethnography, the Ludwig Museum, the House of Terror Museum and House of Music Hungary, so put the baths, the Basilica or the Castle Museum on that day.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Hungarian National Museum, Museum of Ethnography, Ludwig Museum, House of Terror Museum and House of Music Hungary are closed on Mondays. Stand25 is closed on Sundays, and Artizán (Hold utca) is closed on Sundays too.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Hungarian State Opera English tours run daily at 13:30, 15:00 and 16:30, with tickets on sale one week in advance. Hospital in the Rock can only be visited on a guided tour, and Rudas Baths sells night-bathing entry online only.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and queues
toolkit.copy: Gerbeaud takes no reservations and seats guests in order of arrival. New York Café seats walk-ins from 07:00 to 18:00 and takes table bookings only after 18:00, for dinner guests.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Rudas Baths does not admit anyone under 14, and Hospital in the Rock does not admit children under 6. Gundel recommends smart casual dress, and the Hungarian State Opera says it has no official dress code.

guide.dek: Plan museum days from Tuesday to Sunday, keep Monday for the baths or the Basilica, and book dinners and Opera tours ahead.
intro: Budapest's headline sights publish clear hours, which makes it easier for you to plan. St. Stephen's Basilica is open for visits Monday to Saturday from 09.00 to 18.00 and on Sunday from 13.00 to 18.00, while its Panorama Terrace and Treasury open daily from 09.00 to 19.00. Up on Castle Hill, the Castle Museum of the Budapest History Museum opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00, with last entry at 17:30. Matthias Church has a concert programme running into December, including Bach and Charpentier on 19 December 2026.

Many museums close on Mondays. The Hungarian National Museum opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00 and is showing The Treasures of King Louis I (the Great) of Hungary until 31 December 2026, though some halls are closed for renovation. The Museum of Ethnography has A Soldier's Lot until 29 August 2027 and Rituals of Beauty until 4 January 2027. At the Ludwig Museum, Walk This Way. The Art of Walking runs until 31 January 2027, and two floors stay open until 20:00 from Tuesday to Sunday.

For the baths, Széchenyi Thermal Bath opens from 7:00 on weekdays, stays open until 22:00 on Fridays, and opens at 8:00 on holiday days from 18 December 2026 to 6 January 2027. Rudas Baths opens at 6:00, stays open until 22:00 on Mondays, and admits no one under 14. Hospital in the Rock can only be seen on a guided tour, with the last one leaving at 18:00. If you have children with you, Budapest Zoo is open daily and runs a discounted senior autumn programme until 30 November 2026.

For food, the Great Market Hall opens at 06.00 on weekdays and is closed on public holidays. Artizán on Hold utca opens at 07:00 on weekdays, and New York Café opens at 07:00 but takes table bookings only after 18:00, for dinner guests. Stand25 serves lunch and dinner Monday to Saturday, and Rosenstein confirms reservations only by email. Gundel is open all year and is advertising a New Year's Eve dinner on 31 December 2026, and 360 Bar on Andrássy út serves until 02:00 from Thursday to Saturday.
summaryCards: Start at St. Stephen's Basilica and its Panorama Terrace, then take an English tour of the Hungarian State Opera at 13:30, 15:00 or 16:30.
Have coffee at Espresso Embassy from 7:30 on weekdays or pastries at Artizán on Hold utca, then browse the Great Market Hall.
Remember that most major museums close on Mondays, Stand25 closes on Sundays and Rosenstein confirms tables only by email.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Hungarian Parliament site showed a CAPTCHA; the Museum of Fine Arts and Hungarian National Gallery returned HTTP 451; Ruszwurm, High Note SkyBar and Madal Café returned 403; Central Café, Boutiq'Bar, My Little Melbourne, Szimply, Pékműhely, Hopp, Művész Kávéház and Butter Brothers had certificate or TLS errors; several other domains did not resolve. None of these failures is evidence of closure. Matthias Church's weekly schedule was not readable (only one day's hours), Kollázs published no opening hours, the Hungarian State Opera's box office hours were not shown, and the House of Terror Museum's reopening notice gives no year. Espresso Embassy, Artizán, Auguszt and Kollázs showed current hours or booking but no dated 2026 content. Gellért Thermal Bath is closed, with reopening expected in 2028.
